sources.summary: Human Rights news release (29 October 2025): the leaked 11th Judicial Package omnibus draft law would amend the penal and civil codes to criminalise conduct deemed "contrary to biological sex and general morality" (up to three years), sharply restrict gender-affirming healthcare (minimum age 25, onerous eligibility conditions) and allow criminal charges against both trans people and the professionals providing their care; the government's stated justification is protecting "the family" and "public morals"; the package also carries unrelated measures such as longer child sentences and online-content removal.

Kaos GL's LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025, "The Year of the Family: A Major Siege Against LGBTI+ People" (published 24 February 2026): finds that in 2025 anti-LGBTI+ hostility became explicit state policy — centred on the presidency, with the family ministry as the implementing ministry, religious and broadcasting authorities deployed against LGBTI+ people, and the closure of an LGBTI+ rights organisation within this structure.

NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (JS-rendered page; only site navigation in the cache); the underlying bianet report (31 July 2025) covers around 20 trans women rounded up in the Beyoğlu district during ordinary activity — street, shopping, cafés — taken to a police station for identity checks, held about two hours with their names recorded and videos filmed, no official reason given; one detainee: "this is profiling".

outOfScopeNotes: General terrorism and crime advisories affect all travellers to this country regardless of identity; the 2025 draft judicial package's other measures (longer child sentences, online content removal) are not trans-specific.
tangentialFactors: The national "Year of the Family" hostility climate (presidency-centred; implemented through the family ministry, religious and broadcasting authorities) applies in this province as it does nationwide - a broad anti-LGBTI+ climate rather than a trans-specific local policy; no province-specific enforcement of the draft law is documented here yet.
